$comment: A record's summary for a lorebook entry (rpg-ai A15): its plain-text description with every run of whitespace (newlines included) made one space and the ends trimmed. Within limits.summary_characters it stands as it is; longer, it is cut at the last space that leaves room for a closing "…" within the limit (or, with no space there, at the limit less one), trimmed, and "…" is added. Held on the server (server/extensions/wiki_shared/Summary.py), the lite edition (client/src/lib/summary.ts) and rpg-ai, which reads these cases too.
